abilities.source_text: {2}{W}: You gain 3 life.
abilities.cost: Pay {2}{W}; the printed ability has no tap cost or once-per-turn limit.
abilities.effect: The activating controller gains exactly 3 life; do not tie the amount to Zacama's power or choose another recipient.
abilities.target: No targets; you, the activating controller, receive the life.
abilities.timing: Normal activated-ability timing, repeatable with enough mana even on the creature's entry turn.
abilities.replacement: No printed replacement effect; outside life-gain restrictions need their own handling.
abilities.remaining_gap: Production evidence is needed for 3 life per {2}{W} payment, repeat activation without tapping, correct recipient, and a prohibited life gain not refunding its mana cost.

abilities.source_text: Whenever this creature or another creature you control dies, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
abilities.cost: Not applicable: the death trigger has no payment and does not itself sacrifice a creature.
abilities.effect: For each qualifying death, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain exactly 1 life. The gain is once per trigger, not once per opponent, and the losses are not damage.
abilities.target: No targets; the source's own death or another controlled creature's death qualifies, including tokens. Opposing creatures dying do not qualify.
abilities.timing: Trigger on battlefield-to-graveyard deaths with the required last-known battlefield information; simultaneous deaths can include the source and multiple other controlled creatures.
abilities.replacement: No printed replacement effect; exile instead of a graveyard move is not a death event.
abilities.remaining_gap: Production evidence is needed for self-death, token death, multiple simultaneous own deaths with the source, no opposing-death trigger, all-opponent life loss, and only 1 life gained per trigger in multiplayer.
